offering_description.value: Builds and sells new single-family homes and townhomes, primarily to first-time buyers and households moving up to a larger home. It acquires or controls building lots and manages construction through local trade contractors.

customer_segment.value: B2C: First-time homebuyers and buyers moving up to a larger home

revenue_model.value: product sales: New homes sold to buyers at closing

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Uses building lots, materials and subcontracted labor to build homes for individual buyers

geography_served.value: US regional: Southeastern United States and Texas, including Georgia, Alabama, Tennessee and North Carolina

specialization.value: niche specialist: Affordable new-home construction across detached homes and townhomes

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Community sales teams working directly with homebuyers; own locations: Model homes and on-site sales centers; agents / brokers: Independent real estate agents representing homebuyers
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; own locations; agents / brokers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Residential construction is subject to local zoning, building codes, permits and inspections
